title: DriverDocumentDuplicated v1 payload
description: Published by driver when a document is added whose file has the same content (SHA-256) as a document of another driver (issue #105, threat model D2). Aggregate Driver (the driver who added it). Ids only. operations raises at most one DUPLICATE_DOCUMENT risk flag per pair of drivers; it blocks nothing (REQ-SEC-11).

driver_id.description: The driver who added the document.

other_driver_id.description: The driver with the earliest document of the same content.
